lastRequest: Build a fullstack AI Resume Keyword Scanner web application with React, Express, PDF upload parsing, match score calculation, and detailed keyword breakdown.

tasks.title: Database Schema Definition
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma and define PostgreSQL schema for User, Resume, JobDescription, and AnalysisReport models.

tasks.title: Backend Infrastructure & Auth
tasks.description: Setup Express server with JWT authentication, Multer file handling, and validation middleware.

tasks.title: NLP and Analysis Services
tasks.description: Implement PDF parsing logic and integrate OpenAI/natural processing services for resume-JD compatibility scoring.

tasks.title: API Controller Layer
tasks.description: Develop RESTful endpoints for scan submission, history retrieval, and result analysis persistence.

tasks.title: Frontend Implementation
tasks.description: Build React dashboard with Recharts visualizations, file upload handling via React-Dropzone, and React-Query integration.
